data.review_body:
Ordered from SHEIN with a stated delivery window of 23–27 July 2026. The parcel reached the destination airport and then sat there for six days with no tracking movement, and was never released to the local courier.

On 27 July, a customer service representative confirmed in writing, in the app chat, to reach out again the next day and request a full refund then if the order does not. It was not delivered.

I contacted customer service again on 28 July, as instructed. Rather than the promised refund as per the policy of missed ETA deadline, the delivery deadline was moved to 3 August without my agreement.

Customer service was polite throughout (although fully automated bot, not a human being in sight), but every reply repeated the same three points regardless of what I asked: an apology, a request to wait longer, and a note that intercepting the parcel "may fail."

There was no way to reach a supervisor or anyone able to approve a refund directly, and the only concrete option offered was to refuse a delivery that no courier had yet attempted.

I've kept screenshots of the original delivery window, the written refund commitment, and the later change of date, in case anyone from SHEIN wants to look into it.

All I received is a link with a tracking code to track the local courier. However, the package has not even been handed to the local courier and the customer support representative still keeps insisting to check with the courier.

What I'd flag for other buyers is what happens after a delivery date is missed: the promised refund process didn't hold up in my case. Be very careful and cautious. I'll update this review if that changes.


IPDATE, 29 July: SHEIN's reply to this review below asks me to check my email for a resolution, suggesting it may have gone to spam. I did receive their email - it does not contain a resolution, it repeats the same request to wait, this time until 3 August. The reply to this review describes an email that doesn't match the one I actually got.
data.review_headline: Missed delivery deadline, then extended it instead of honouring the promised refund

data.review_body: False information logistics failure TEMU platform never police said it would  be 2 working days for delivery, so I purchase it then it said it will   arrive in 21 working false of sale trapping the general of public to secure the sale with false information there was no mention on the description that it was a pre-order and it will take 21 days or it said it was it was  a local warehouse in  the UK.lies! .then later to find out  that there was shipping processing orders from China over to the local warehouse in the UK, then send out delivery never explained this within the selling platform trust me I would never purchase again  from TEMU that experience with customer service they’re like robots can’t repeating myself avoiding the point of an argument. These people do not care cause they’re not within our country. They have no respect for the UK Low  under the sales. Good act 2015.

Unfortunately, I have had nothing but bad experiences with Temu. The shop is only good as long as everything works. However, once a technical problem occurs, it becomes almost impossible to get any real help.
No matter what questions you ask, you keep receiving the same pre-written, meaningless responses. I have been trying to resolve my issue for over a month. I simply can't stand reading these polite, robotic phrases anymore.
In the end, I am going to lose EUR 350.00. I feel completely trapped in a maze of incompetence. It has already cost me an enormous amount of time, and by now I have realized that Temu's robots have more persistence than any customer. No matter what I write—even though communicating through the app is already very time-consuming—I always receive exactly the same automated replies.
When you contact customer service, they tell you that "experts" are handling your case. However, those so-called experts end up sending the same meaningless responses as customer service.
Never again, Temu!

BUYER BEWARE OF TEMU'S SCAMS;
Temu regularly has screens filled with stars informing you that you have won 7 free items.
I have always been sceptical of this kind of marketing.
However, one day I had time to follow the prompts to access the 7 free items.  The articles of clothing very clearly came up on the screen with 'FREE' written above them.
I placed my order for the few minor things I wanted and clicked on 7 free garment's.  Then before logging off Temu App on my phone I got a second message 'You have won 7 more free items.' So I ordered another few items as instructed to get the 7 free marked articles of clothing.
WHEN I GOT MY VISA CARD BILL I WAS CHARGED FOR THE 14 'FREE' ITEMS.
I HAVE BEEN TRYING TO GET A REFUND FOR 2 MONTHS NOW WITH NO LUCK.
ALL I GET AMOST EVERY 2ND DAY IS EMAILS REFERRING ME TO ANOTHER MEMBER OF THE TEAM WHO WILL  INVESTIGATE WHAT HAPPENED.
PLUS WITH AN INSULT OFFER OF A $30 VOUCHER FOR $500 WORTH OF "FREE" ARTICLES OF CLOTHING THEY SCAMMED OUT OF ME.
